semantics.scope: all family native timing and habitat plus ordinary-wild eligibility; no surface, pool, table or slot assignments
semantics.nativeWindow: Ventana de primera disponibilidad de la familia comparada entre FireRed/LeafGreen, Gold/Silver/Crystal y Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald. Se toma la adquisición utilizable más temprana de cualquier juego o versión y se eleva por el gate del método.
semantics.sourceSelection: earliest effective acquisition across FRLG, GSC and RSE; effective window is max(area window, method gate)
semantics.entrySpecies: immediate non-baby evolution for each of the ten baby-bearing families; otherwise the lowest National Dex species among the evidence rows that establish the earliest window
semantics.babySpecies: the ten generation I-III baby species remain family members but never materialize in ordinary wild tables
semantics.fossilSpecies: all five fossil families are excluded from ordinary wild tables
semantics.networkUsage: none during normal generation; refresh is a separate explicit command and the resulting snapshot is committed
